recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Further Task state progression or scope guidance discussions should proceed under their own Jira issues, not as follow-up to this narrow Created-to-Draft correction.
issue_request: FHIR-19489 was an Applied/Persuasive OO change request for R6. It reported that Task section 12.1.2.2 said Tasks start in a Created state even though Task.status is required-bound to TaskStatus, which has no Created code, and the resolution was to replace Created with Draft.
initial_application: The issue was already applied before this reconciliation. The Jira snapshot records that the change was added to the build, and local source history shows ff032a3110 changing source/task/task-notes.xml from Created to Draft in both the starting-state sentence and the non-terminal state list, followed by 8bcebf4320 whitespace cleanup.
additional_context: Task is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/task/task-notes.xml is in build scope. Task.status remains required-bound to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/task-status, and the TaskStatus code system includes draft/requested but no created code. OO Confluence minutes in April/May 2024 list FHIR-19489 as a Task-specific consistency item; no Zulip discussion or conflicting community evidence was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already says Tasks start in a Draft state, uses Draft in the non-terminal state list, and a source-wide check found no remaining Task Created-state wording to fix.

related_jiras.note: OO minutes grouped FHIR-42895 with Task-specific tickets, but it addresses broader Task scope/usage guidance rather than the FHIR-19489 Created-to-Draft wording correction.
